note: World Bank PAD; stored text ends mid-sentence at para 66. Para 19 names the 'Government at Your Hands Digitalization Strategy (2024-2028)' as positioning the Ministry of ICT as lead coordinator, and para 52 names 'Eswatini's Digital Transformation Strategy 2024-2028 (Government in Your Hand)' as envisioning moving services online (e-health, digital IDs, licensing, tax, utilities). The document describes it as services-only, so it is classed government and no fact is recorded; the parent may reclassify (period 2024-2028 stated; text public: not stated; MICT lead coordinator per para 19; PAD component 2 finances it at US$25.0m, IDA/IBRD).
